messages:
maria: quick heads-up — enterprise prospect wants explicit contract language: 7-year searchable audit log retention + tenant-level export within 48h. They say SOC2 auditor will require it. thoughts on feasibility and launch criteria?

aj: 7 years is long but doable with cold tiering. main questions: index/search SLA vs storage cost, and whether BYOK applies for archived logs.

samir: from security POV BYOK for logs is tricky — we can KMS-wrap archived blobs but searchability requires either key access or a separate index that doesn't include plaintext. need legal input on what 'searchable' means.

lee: ops note: current pipeline keeps 1y hot index + 2y warm + cold blob archive beyond that. adding 7y searchable means either expensive index growth or an index snapshot+query fallback (slower). rough numbers: 7y searchable ~= 6-8x current infra cost for indexing; cold-archive with on-demand reindexing would be 1.3x.

nora: customer insists on "searchable" meaning auditor can run queries. Could we offer two tiers: "searchable-fast" (1y SLA) and "searchable-archived" (reindex within 48h)?

maria: that two-tier sounds promising. ask: how complex is implementing reindex-on-demand with retention policy + contract SLA?

aj: implementable but needs new infra flow: archive with metadata catalog, rehydrate + reindex job + query proxy that routes to reindexed results. estimate 6-8 sprint effort across eng infra + search.

diane: dependencies: KMS/escrow for BYOK customers, legal sign-off on data export window, and telemetry to prove SLA. We should define acceptance criteria: 1) contract text for retention, 2) reindex SLA measured on beta datasets, 3) BYOK compatibility documented.

samir: security acceptance: documented key handling for cold blobs (wrapped with customer's CMK), audit trail for rehydration, and role-based access for on-demand indexing. also need threat model update.

maria: proposed next steps: 1) product to draft contract options (fast vs archived searchable) + pricing delta, 2) eng to estimate work and risk, 3) security to produce BYOK constraints and required controls, 4) legal to draft example contract clause. can owners volunteer?

aj: eng can own estimation + spike for reindex flow.

samir: security will draft BYOK constraints and an initial threat model by EOD next Wed.

lee: ops will prototype rehydrate job on a small tenant and report performance metrics (reindex time / cost) in 2 weeks.

maria: perfect. I will draft contract option language and pricing proposal, share in this thread once ready. tagging @aj @samir @lee @nora for visibility. :thumbsup:
